taxi.title: Taxis
taxi.hint: Door 7 at T3, door 3 at T4
taxi.text: City taxis wait on the arrivals level, at automatic door 7 in T3 and door 3 in T4. For journeys to Quanzhou, Shishi and Zhangzhou, separate taxis can be found in the west car park, about 120 m west of the exit from the T3 domestic arrivals hall. The 24-hour complaints number is +86 592 5615610.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: Baggage storage counters are in the arrivals halls of T3 and T4 and are open from 05:30 until arriving flights have finished. Charges apply per 24 hours; any period shorter than 24 hours is charged as a full period. Phone numbers: T3 — +86 592 5706036, T4 — +86 592 5706016.

wifi.title: Terminal Wi-Fi
wifi.text: CMCC-XMAirport-free, ChinaUnicom and Chinanet networks are available in terminal passenger areas. China Mobile and China Unicom access is free, while China Telecom is paid; payment terms appear on the operator’s login page. Wi-Fi is available from the start to the end of flight operations.

lounges.title: Lounges for premium passengers
lounges.text: The T4 domestic lounge is to the left after security, following the signs, and serves first- and business-class passengers on flights ground-handled by the airport free of charge. Rest facilities, food and internet are included; it opens at 06:00 and closes after the last first-class passenger has boarded. The airport’s international lounge is in T3 by boarding gate 17 and provides the same services for first- and business-class passengers on flights handled by the airport.
